item.title: github: Add VS Code Agents to Copilot usage metrics
item.description:
GitHub Copilot usage metrics now include generally available activity metrics for the dedicated VS Code Agents window. This lets enterprises and organizations track adoption and engagement for VS Code Agents alongside other Copilot usage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot usage metrics API adds agent app activity
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now includes activity from agent apps used in GitHub workflows. This extends usage reporting to agents from partners such as Claude and Codex.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New Copilot usage metrics impact dashboard
item.description:
GitHub released a new Copilot metrics impact dashboard for enterprise administrators and organization owners. It is meant to help them report Copilot impact using usage metrics and related data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Repository-level GitHub Copilot usage metrics generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot usage metrics REST API now includes repository-level activity. Two new endpoints provide a daily per-repository breakdown of pull request activity for Copilot coding agent and Copilot code review.

  • Source: GitHub
